Name: Plantable Palm Trees
Author: MouseyPounds
Description:
[b]Description:

[color=#ffff00]Plantable Palm Trees[/color][/b] is a SMAPI mod which allows you to plant coconuts to grow palm trees; it also optionally allows you to plant red and purple mushrooms to grow mushroom trees. Planting mechanics mirror that of acorns, maple seeds, and pinecones. Either the tool use button (left-click with keyboard controls) or action button (right-click with keyboard controls) will work, and hoeing the ground first is only necessary outside the farm. To avoid accidental planting, the mod can be configured to require a keypress as well. This and other options are set in the [i]config.json[/i] file; this file is not included with the download and will be automatically created the first time the game is run with the mod loaded.


[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the download and place the included [color=#b6d7a8][code]PlantablePalmTrees[/code][/color] folder into your [color=#b6d7a8][code]Mods[/code][/color] folder.
[/list]

[b]Configuration:
[/b]
[list]
[*][color=#6d9eeb][b]Use_Modifier_Key[/b][/color] lets you choose whether an additional key needs to be held down in addition to clicking. Choices are [color=#b4a7d6][i]false[/i] [/color](default) or [i][color=#b4a7d6]true[/color][/i].
[*][color=#6d9eeb][b]Modifier_Key[/b][/color] is the key to use if the previous option is enabled. There is a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]list of valid key codes[/url] on the wiki. The default is [color=#b4a7d6][i]LeftAlt[/i] [/color].
[*][color=#6d9eeb][b]Require_Tilled_Soil[/b][/color] lets you choose whether tiles on the Farm must be tilled first. Choices are [color=#b4a7d6][i]false[/i] [/color](default) or [i][color=#b4a7d6]true[/color][/i].
[*][color=#6d9eeb][b]Show_Placement_Icon[/b][/color] lets you choose whether to highlight the tile under your cursor the same way other tree seeds work. Choices are [color=#b4a7d6][i]true[/i] [/color](default) or [i][color=#b4a7d6]false[/color][/i].
[*][color=#6d9eeb][b]Enable_Mushroom_Tree_Planting[/b][/color] lets you choose whether to plant mushroom trees with red and purple mushrooms. Choices are [color=#b4a7d6][i]true[/i][/color] or [i][color=#b4a7d6]false[/color][/i] (default).
[*][color=#6d9eeb][b]Enable_Planting_in_Mines[/b][/color] lets you choose whether you can plant palm and mushroom trees in the mines. Choices are [color=#b4a7d6][i]true[/i][/color] or [i][color=#b4a7d6]false[/color][/i] (default).
[/list]

[b]Compatibility:
[/b]
[b][color=#ffff00]Plantable Palm Trees[/color][/b] requires [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] version 3.0.0 or higher and should work with Stardew Valley 1.4 or higher.


[b]Additional Notes:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Because this copies the standard mechanics of other seeds, if you click far from your character while holding a coconut but there is a valid spot right next to your character, a tree will be planted in that closer valid spot.
[*]Thanks to f4ith (AKA [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7187759]JertsukkaTheMan[/url]) for advice on how to start.
[/list]
